title: Trader Diary: 78k BTC & My 10x Leverage Dream
content:
BTC at $78,493, I whisper "just one more candle"
Check the chart, see green, place 10x, heart rate hits 180
30 seconds later: "Why is my margin call louder than my alarm?"
lesson: Never let FOMO dictate leverage—set your max risk before the hype.
question: Who else just turned a 2% dip into a 200% panic trade? 🙋‍♂️👇
